meta.name: Ganesh Sweets — Heritage Editorial
meta.description: Latest stakeholder homepage reference: festive hero and category imagery extracted directly from the supplied 1024x1536 composition. Real storefront supplied separately replaces mockup storefront. Newsletter omitted at stakeholder request. Existing catalogue prices, business information, brand palette and golden ambience preserved.

color.palette_type: warm neutrals with maroon and antique gold

neutral.usage: light surfaces, muted body text, dark foreground; measured darkest cluster #2b100a reflects reference image foreground

color.contrast_strategy: dark on light; decorative gold darkened to #80642F for small text

font_families.heading: Georgia for reference-matched homepage/header; Cormorant Garamond for existing interior pages

typography.font_style_notes: Reference uses a broader, sturdier serif than the initial Cormorant treatment; homepage and wordmark now use Georgia.

spacing.section_rhythm: Main homepage sections: clamp(40px,4vw,64px) equally top and bottom; 40px on phone/tablet. Hero and image banner use corresponding interior spacing.

layout.grid_system: editorial two-column hero and responsive product grids
layout.max_content_width: 1200px homepage including category grid and footer; 650px at widths780px and below
layout.columns: compact editorial split hero; six category cards
layout.alignment_tendency: shared left alignment for header, headline and trust row; centered category heading

elevation.depth_cues: inset photo edge, hovering cards, overlapping heritage seal

iconography.style: fine outlined icons and floral linework

motion.entrance_pattern: opacity and short vertical translation; slow photo settling
motion.exit_pattern: bow loosens, ribbons pull outward, wrapping panels separate

components.button_style: maroon pill with inset arrow disc; quiet story link; rounded rectangular product enquiry
components.input_style: warm surface, visible labels, clear focus
components.navigation_pattern: sticky header, active underline, collapsed mobile navigation
components.modal_style: full viewport ivory introduction with skip control
components.list_style: clean responsive product and service grids
components.component_notes: Hero photo blends into ivory without arch, floating badge or caption. Four compact trust highlights. Verified catalogue categories only.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a carefully wrapped box of traditional sweets
aesthetic.era_influence: Indian heritage with contemporary editorial restraint

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous around typography, compact within cards
visual_language.contrast_level: high legibility with soft surface contrast
visual_language.texture_usage: satin weave in intro; food photography provides texture

composition.negative_space_role: compact editorial rhythm, categories visible directly after trust row

imagery.photo_treatment: warm original public-site food images, cropped without distortion
imagery.graphic_elements: Gold heritage linework repeated at alternating section edges, using the existing motif geometry; cropped and subdued to protect content.
imagery.pattern_usage: one low-opacity floral motif in hero
imagery.image_shape: unframed blended hero; shallow pavilion category silhouette; existing rounded product cards

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: small lift and restrained image zoom

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: helpful plain text and reset option

overview.fallback_strategy: CSS satin and radial glow; instant reveal for reduced motion

background_effects.description: Broad masked champagne light, strongest around upper-right imagery; no photograph distortion
background_effects.technology: shaders/react MeshGradient and RadialGradient with CSS fallback

shader_effects.description: Satin clipped to bow silhouette; aura begins after intro so canvases do not overlap

params.fragment_output: maroon satin and warm gold atmosphere

text_effects.description: whole text elements fade up after intro

cursor_effects.description: aura and image move a few pixels in the hero

image_effects.description: gentle product image zoom and hero settling

svg_animations.description: SVG motifs and masks are static; parent ribbon transforms use GSAP

params.filter_effects: static color matrix and SourceAlpha compositing; no blur

visual_effects.composite_notes: Hero is the exact lossless 554x267 crop of the supplied composition, with CSS edge masks. Storefront uses references /storefront.png. Existing shader and ribbon preserved. No generated replacement hero or storefront was produced. Heritage refinement: supplied floral screenshot reused as a symmetric static edge ornament; supplied architectural screenshot reused at the story and About page. Static SVG color matrices remove paper and tint the original strokes, with no invented landmark labels. Existing shader radial light uses #C69A57 at .12 opacity; no additional shader instance.
